feeds.title: TeacherToolkit Blog
feeds.description: TeacherToolkit is the most Influential Blog on Education in the UK. Teacher Toolkit provides teachers with access to resources that are meaningful for any classroom. This website is run by Ross McGill, an award-winning deputy head teacher working in North London.

feeds.title: ICTEvangelist Blog
feeds.description: Award-winning blogger, author, & speaker Mark Anderson combines his knowledge of technology & teaching to share his passion for learning & tech innovation. Drawing on his experience as an assistant headteacher, Mark uses his blog to give classroom advice for educators, app ideas to encourage learning, and personal anecdotes.

feeds.title: teacherhead
feeds.description: Zest for Learning... into the rainforest of teaching and school leadership. Written by Tom Sherrington, a head teacher and teacher in London, this site explores contemporary ideas in teaching and learning and school leadership. He writes about everything from ideas for teaching to grading lessons.

feeds.title: Impact Teachers Blog
feeds.description: The latest news, teacher resources, insightful education articles and classroom ideas! Impact was founded on the principle of creating outstanding schools and acquiring passionate teachers who can engage and inspire students both locally and globally.

feeds.title: Resourceaholic
feeds.description: Ideas and resources for teaching secondary school mathematics. With everything from Star Wars puzzles to mathematical handwriting, it's an award-winning blog for all things maths. Written by Jo Morgan, a Maths Teacher.

feeds.title: Class Teaching
feeds.description: With content which focuses on how to improve CPD (continuing professional development), ideas on how to improve the teaching and learning experience, and information on speaking sessions held at the school, the blog attracts a network of teachers who are on the search for resources to help them in their careers.

feeds.title: The Learning Spy
feeds.description: The Learning Spy is an brain food for the thinking teacher. David Didau runs this blog which is widely recognised as one of the most influential education blogs in the UK.

feeds.title: Emile Education Blog
feeds.description: Emile Education - Resources that Work for Teachers & Schools and that Children Love! Welcome Emile, Aimee & Scrambler into your Classroom, and see the difference. Here are our tips, hints, and news stories about Emile and teaching. We hope you enjoy them!

feeds.title: Magical Maths
feeds.description: Magical Maths is a fun and friendly site that was set up in early 2007 to act as a learning hub for teachers around the world. The site receives thousands of visits per day and has developed into an influential educational site where educators across the globe share resources and strategies.

feeds.title: Teacher Tapp
feeds.description: A great source of CPD for teachers, useful insights that can improve teaching practice, and data showcasing educators' thoughts and opinions. Teacher Tapp is a daily survey app where thousands of teachers answer daily questions so their collective opinions can be heard and used to inform school leaders, media, policymakers, and organizations creating products for schools.
